verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a tax e-filing portal could offer a keyless or file-number entry path. However, ELSTER's published pages state that paperless filing requires a one-time registration in Mein ELSTER, and receipt upload works only after login. No page documents starting the core flow without an account. The third-party software channel and the einfachELSTER mentions are not documented as account-free entry paths.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
